<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-security`, touching **18** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/index.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class), canReadObject (symbol, a method of class SecurityPlugin; a top-level function), resolveProjectionFieldMask (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via canReadObject (symbol, a method of class SecurityPlugin; a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via canReadObject (symbol, a method of class SecurityPlugin; a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **18** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7257f57a68e250653d06fa448895c1a8abd7e179` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1e6815fa962e37d3d0ae4a8825e888686e040ea6` — the merge of head `1bf877186c3a56a634b4e56104d9924ddeb74210` into base `7257f57a68e250653d06fa448895c1a8abd7e179`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1e6815fa962e37d3d0ae4a8825e888686e040ea6 && git checkout 1e6815fa962e37d3d0ae4a8825e888686e040ea6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7257f57a68e250653d06fa448895c1a8abd7e179 1bf877186c3a56a634b4e56104d9924ddeb74210 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7257f57a68e250653d06fa448895c1a8abd7e179 && git merge --no-ff 1bf877186c3a56a634b4e56104d9924ddeb74210

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7257f57a68e250653d06fa448895c1a8abd7e179
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7257f57a68e250653d06fa448895c1a8abd7e179` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzuZJBQY4wUQFJbkfx

## 维护者速读 · PR #33202 @ `1bf87718` · 2026-11-14T03:21Z

- 改了什么：OAuth 代理（代某人执行的 MCP 客户端）调 `list_objects` 时，安全服务对每个对象都要重新解析一次被代理人（11 条语句，每对象两次）。现在同一请求上下文内只解析一次：按上下文挂一个 WeakMap 备忘，键为被代理人、租户与组织成员 id，权限纪元一变就作废，解析失败不记。
- 为什么改：#33179，owner 的代理列 150 个对象要 4620 条语句，约 44 秒；改后恒为 11 条，与对象数无关。
- 权限与边界：不变。备忘只在一个请求上下文里复用，任何写入都会推进纪元而立即作废，所以撤销授权或移除成员在同一请求内也立刻生效。登录会话和 API key 不带 `onBehalfOf`，不受影响。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `plugin-security` 的两处读取入口和测试，没有数据或存储变化。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`security-plugin.ts` 的 `resolveDelegatorForContext`，以及 `security-plugin-object-admission.ts` 与 `security-plugin-field-readers.ts` 两处接入点。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：落地。`Clause-② no`，席位自审 PASS；CI 无失败，没有碰受管面，改动 515 行。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** draft → `main`。正文写 `Fixes #33179`，合并后应当关卡；正文其他地方没有挨着别的 open 卡号的闭合关键词。
  - 申报 `Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`；`@objectstack/plugin-security` patch。
  - 文件面 = 认领 6868398958 加修订 6868565123（plugin-security 的委托解析备忘与它的身份、失效钉），6 个文件都在其中。
- **前提实测:** dev 报告 6869800389。`main` 上 OAuth owner 代理在 10 → 150 个对象时为 1540 → 4620 条语句，`describe_object` 为 22 条；本 PR 为 11 → 11 条与 11 条。API key 与登录会话在两边都是 0 条。
- **门禁 check-runs @ `1bf87718`:** 35 success、16 skipped、0 失败、0 进行中。
- **第二轮（`04753f4b` → `1bf87718`）:** 合入 `origin/main` 66919b66（无冲突，`main` 未改 plugin-security），再加一次提交，只改了 `packages/runtime/src/mcp-list-objects-statements.pin.test.ts`，其余 5 个文件逐字节不变。
  - 起因：Test Core 3/8 上 owner 的 golden sha256 不符，而计数相同。在 `04753f4b` 的干净树上，旧钉 19/19 通过。合并后，两件已合入 `main` 的变化改了哈希：#33170 给 `sys_sso_provider` 加了一个字段（仅 owner 可见，15 → 16），#33180 把 `sys_user` 加进了四个调用者的 `sys_*` 读取白名单。备忘本身没有改变任何答案。
  - 新钉：同一棵树里，每个调用者在 10 和 150 个对象时各读两遍，一遍走备忘，一遍绕过备忘（每次询问前删掉该上下文的备忘项，即 `main` 的逐对象解析），两次答案必须深相等。CONTROL：绕过时的语句数仍随对象数增长；`describe_object` 两边答案相同，备忘一边不更贵。冻结的 golden 与 sha256 已删。20/20 通过。
  - 消融：A（关掉备忘接入）3 红；B（关掉纪元检查）1 红，即失效钉；C（备忘命中时返回错误的解析结果）4 红，包括 memberAgent 的新身份钉；复原后 20/20，`preflight --absent` 为 0，树干净。
- **契约复审:** `Clause-② no`，没有碰契约四面，所以由席位自审，不另派复审者：
  - 备忘键包含被代理人、租户和组织成员 id，换人、换租户、换组织都会落到新的项；
  - 纪元不符即重新解析，解析被拒（抛错）不进备忘，下一次询问会重试；
  - 存入的解析结果已冻结，调用方无法改写共享项；
  - 只有 `canReadObject` 与 `resolveProjectionFieldMask` 两处接入，没有改动这两处的判断逻辑；
  - WeakMap 以上下文对象为键，请求结束、上下文被回收后备忘随之释放；每个入口每个请求都新建上下文（认领修订的条件），所以备忘不会跨请求。
- **接受的偏差:** PR 正文有几处仍写的是第一轮，正文不改，以本条为准：
  - 「golden 钉」「answer-identity golden … taken from the main-side run」「The golden hashes still matched」三处：现在是同一棵树里备忘与绕过两条路径深相等，见上文。
  - 「两分钟验证」应为 20/20 通过，不是 19/19。
  - 「Verification」应以 `1bf87718` 为准；sha256 表已删，以上面的读数为准。
- **范围外去向:** 无。
- **落地条款:** 维护者常设落地令 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30T14:20Z)；本卡按「mcp 相关 p2 任务也可以派发处理」 (2026-11-13T15:50Z) 入本席。
  - 非受管面：`check-governed-merges --pr 33202` 判定 0/6 命中。515 行 ≤ 3000。
  - K = 1（PRBASE `7257f57a`，取自 Plan Test Core shards 的 Affected-set diff base；`origin/main` 为 `67274aca`，即 #33172，只改 hono 请求体上限，与本 PR 无交集）。`git merge-tree` 无冲突。
  - 没有新的语种包。
